form_cost_share_etraining: Self-paced Articulate Rise module that explains cost sharing on sponsored projects — the portion of total project costs not funded by the granting agency and instead provided by MSU or a third party through cash or in-kind contributions. Covers the different types of cost share, the step-by-step process for getting approvals and documentation right, practical tips for tracking from day one, and how to use the project's Banner cost share activity code.
form_navigating_banner_etraining: Self-paced Articulate Rise module showing PIs and support staff how to review grant-funded activity in Banner. Covers reviewing project budget, encumbrances (funds held for future spending), budget transfers, and cost transfers. Recommended for anyone who manages or monitors a Banner grant index at MSU.
form_post_award_quick_guide_etraining: Self-paced Articulate Rise interactive training module that introduces PIs and research staff to the post-award lifecycle at Morgan State University. Contains 9 sub-modules: (1) establishing guidelines using the Notice of Award; (2) determining allowable costs/expenses/activities; (3) setting up the award in Banner and introducing spending instruments; (4) troublesome expenses and audit-finding risks; (5) other compliance matters; (6) reporting requirements; (7) prior approvals required from the funding agency; (8) ORA resources; (9) responsible officers at MSU. Use after a new award is received as the recommended first stop before deeper module training.
form_purchasing_banner_pool_08_etraining: Self-paced Articulate Rise module on procurement activities posted to the 08: Contractual Services Banner pool on sponsored projects. Covers procuring vendor goods and services, entering requisitions in Banner, and establishing subawards. Use when planning purchases or subaward spending on a grant.
form_summer_contracts_interactive: Articulate Rise interactive training module on Summer Contracts for Grant-Supported Faculty and Staff at Morgan State University. Created by Ryan Mobley (CRA) and originally delivered as a D-RED seminar on 2024-04-10. Self-paced — walks through summer contract policies, eligibility, rate calculations, and the routing workflow. Companion Zoom recording: https://morganstate.zoom.us/rec/share/lI4o9UmvRA3QjzFXUJuWFNU5Pd8GdYj6G7jsFj2Z97Wv2s7Pc51vqFarGU6atSu1.5Q2_odFD6aCH-kbt
form_supporting_participants_etraining: Self-paced Articulate Rise module on participant support costs in sponsored projects. Covers participant stipends, student tuition and healthcare coverage, participant travel, and the budget concepts that frame these costs: indirect costs, Modified Total Direct Costs (MTDC), and why participant support is excluded from MTDC. Designed to help research staff process participant payments compliantly and avoid common errors.
form_time_effort_etraining: Self-paced Articulate Rise module that demystifies the time and effort reporting process at MSU. Explains the federal certification mechanism by which faculty, staff, and students account for time and related salary costs spent on research projects, and walks through MSU's certification workflow. Distinct from the legacy D-RED Time & Effort interactive at rise.articulate.com/share/YUeYo_t7gEEPZQPjwbuFNy3UD03HIsYQ — this eTraining version is the current canonical module.
form_travel_sponsored_projects_etraining: Self-paced Articulate Rise module covering grant-funded travel from authorization through reimbursement. Walks through key MSU policy and federal Uniform Guidance rules, how to submit travel authorization requests properly, and how to file reimbursement claims that pass compliance review. Useful for PIs and staff traveling on sponsored projects or processing others' travel.
